common.offline: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: To see and download everything that was shared.
signIn.noPassword: No password yet? Set one in the app under Settings › Password, or ask for an invite.
signIn.pinInstead: Only sending? Enter a PIN instead
signIn.wrongLeft.one: Wrong username or password. 1 try left.
signIn.wrongLeft.other: Wrong username or password. {n} tries left.
signIn.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {time}.
signIn.noCookie: This browser didn't keep the sign-in. Allow cookies for this site and try again.
signIn.signedOut: This browser was signed out. Sign in again.
settings.signedInAtHome: Signed in at home: this works only on the home network
settings.passwordNone: None yet: set one to sign in on other phones and computers
theme.autoDetail: Linen by day, Ember at night
devices.title: Your phones and browsers
devices.lead: Where you're signed in. Sign out a phone or browser you no longer use, or one on someone else's computer.
devices.signOutBody: To come back it needs a new invite or the password.
password.lead: For signing in on other phones and computers, also without an invite.
password.wrongLeft.one: The current password is wrong. 1 try left.
password.wrongLeft.other: The current password is wrong. {n} tries left.
password.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {time}.
password.usernameBad: 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.body: Sign out of this browser? You can come back with an invite or your password.
delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.body: All your phones and browsers get signed out. The files you sent stay for everyone.
delete.lastAdmin: You're the only admin. Make someone else admin first.
library.empty: Nothing here yet. What people send shows up here, by the day it arrived.
send.lead: No PIN needed while you're signed in. Everything arrives unchanged, in full quality.
send.noPinNeeded: You're signed in, so no PIN is needed.
viewer.noPreview: No preview for this file. Download it to open it.
viewer.cantShow: This browser can't show this photo. Download it to see it.
viewer.cantPlay: This browser can't play this video. Download it to watch it.
select.tipTouch: Tap a day's circle to select all of it. Long-press and drag to select many at once.
select.tipMouse: Click a day's circle to select all of it. Shift-click selects everything in between.
delete.filesBody: They'll be gone for everyone. For {days} days you can still bring them back from Recently deleted.
zip.started: Downloading {n} files as one ZIP, {size}. Your browser shows how far it is.
zip.tooMany: That's more than 10,000 files. Download them a few days at a time.
zip.busy: Two downloads are already running. Try again when one is done.
share.tooMany: Share up to 10 files, 50 MB, at once. Download the rest instead.
